en: This morning, we're doing our grocery shopping.
zh: 今天早上，我们要去买菜。

en: We're buying food that we'll cook and eat during the week.
zh: 我们要买这周做饭和吃饭要用的食物。

en: In Australia, we don't usually use plastic carry bags at grocery stores.
zh: 在澳大利亚，我们在杂货店通常不用塑料购物袋。

en: We need to bring our own reusable bags.
zh: 我们得自己带可重复使用的袋子。

en: Reusable means that we can use them again and again.
zh: 可重复使用的意思是，我们可以一遍又一遍地使用它们。

en: They're not disposable. Sometimes you can buy paper bags, but most people bring their own.
zh: 它们不是一次性的。有时候你可以买纸袋，不过大多数人都会自己带袋子。

en: The market is on the other side of the road.
zh: 市场就在马路的另一边。

en: We'll wait for the light to turn green.
zh: 我们等绿灯亮了再走。

en: Now that it's green, we can cross and head into the market.
zh: 现在绿灯了，我们可以过马路进市场了。

en: We'll go through these automatic doors.
zh: 我们会从这些自动门进去。

en: Automatic doors open by themselves.
zh: 自动门会自己打开。

en: Now we're inside the market.
zh: 现在我们已经进到市场里面了。

en: Let's have a look around.
zh: 我们四处看看吧。

en: This shelf is full of cheese.
zh: 这个货架上摆满了奶酪。

en: There are small round wheels and pieces cut into smaller parts.
zh: 有小小的圆形奶酪轮，也有切成更小块的奶酪。

en: These shelves are refrigerated to keep the cheese fresh.
zh: 这些货架是冷藏的，这样奶酪才能保持新鲜。

en: Over here, there are olives and pickles.
zh: 这边有橄榄和腌菜。

en: The olives are in round plastic containers.
zh: 这些橄榄装在圆形塑料盒里。

en: They're stacked very neatly.
zh: 它们摆放得非常整齐。

en: Next to the olives is a bakery with beautiful cakes and sweets.
zh: 橄榄旁边有一家面包甜点铺，里面有漂亮的蛋糕和甜点。

en: There's a plate of pink meringues.
zh: 这里有一盘粉色的蛋白霜小点。

en: They're piled up high.
zh: 它们堆得高高的。

en: A meringue is a sweet dessert made from egg whites and sugar.
zh: 蛋白霜是一种用蛋白和糖做成的甜点。

en: It's soft inside and a little crispy on the outside.
zh: 里面是软的，外面有一点酥脆。

en: There are tarts and a big round pie.
zh: 这里还有水果塔和一个大大的圆派。

en: They're also selling square slices of chocolate cake.
zh: 他们也在卖一块块方形的巧克力蛋糕。

en: Each slice has a strawberry on top.
zh: 每一块上面都放着一颗草莓。

en: Since it's Easter, they're selling hot cross buns.
zh: 因为现在是复活节，他们在卖十字面包。

en: There's sweet bread rolls with fruit and a cross on top.
zh: 这里有甜面包卷，里面有果干，上面还有一个十字。

en: Let's walk further into the market.
zh: 我们继续往市场里面走吧。

en: There's a big flower shop in the middle.
zh: 市场中间有一家很大的花店。

en: A person who sells flowers is called a florist.
zh: 卖花的人叫花艺师。

en: You buy flowers from the florist.
zh: 你可以从花艺师那里买花。

en: The flowers are bright and colorful.
zh: 这些花颜色鲜亮，很好看。

en: They're sitting in buckets of water on the ground.
zh: 它们插在地上一桶桶的水里。

en: You can buy one bunch of flowers or you can make a bouquet out of a few bunches.
zh: 你可以买一束花，也可以用几束花搭配成一个花束。

en: A bouquet is a group of flowers arranged together.
zh: 花束就是搭配在一起的一组花。

en: Next to the florist is a stall selling kimchi and other Korean side dishes.
zh: 花店旁边有一个摊位，卖泡菜和其他韩式小菜。

en: I know a lot of you who watch my videos are Korean,
zh: 我知道很多看我视频的人都是韩国人，

en: so I hope it's nice to see that you can find some fresh Korean food
zh: 所以如果你们决定来墨尔本玩，希望看到这里能买到一些新鲜的韩餐会让你们觉得开心。

en: if you decide to visit Melbourne.
zh: 如果你决定来墨尔本的话。

en: Now we're at the green grocer in the corner of the market.
zh: 现在我们来到市场角落里的蔬果店了。

en: This is where we'll buy most of our groceries today.
zh: 今天我们大部分食材都会在这里买。

en: They sell fruit and veggies.
zh: 这里卖水果和蔬菜。

en: Veggies is short for vegetables.
zh: Veggies 是 vegetables 的简略说法。

en: They have boxes of mixed fruit and veggies on these shelves.
zh: 这些货架上放着一箱箱混合搭配的水果和蔬菜。

en: These boxes have a variety of items in them.
zh: 这些箱子里装着各种各样的东西。

en: A variety means many different kinds.
zh: variety 的意思是很多不同的种类。

en: What do you think we would use from this box?
zh: 你觉得这一箱里哪些东西是我们会用到的？

en: The cauliflower, the bananas, the grapes.
zh: 花椰菜、香蕉、葡萄。

en: I don't think we would use the avocados.
zh: 我觉得牛油果我们应该用不上。

en: We already have kale at home.
zh: 我们家里已经有羽衣甘蓝了。

en: Maybe we should just pick individual.
zh: 也许我们还是单独挑吧。

en: Yeah, let's get individual fruits and vegetables.
zh: 对，咱们还是单独挑水果和蔬菜吧。

en: Instead of buying a box, we'll choose our own items.
zh: 不买整箱的话，我们就自己选想要的东西。

en: So... I'll grab a cauliflower.
zh: 那……我拿一个花椰菜。

en: Oh yeah, let's get a cauliflower.
zh: 哦对，我们拿一个花椰菜吧。

en: We'll put one half of the cauliflower into our bag.
zh: 我们会把半个花椰菜放进袋子里。

en: We can pick seven items for $20.
zh: 我们可以挑七样东西，总共20美元。

en: That's a pretty good deal.
zh: 这价格相当划算。

en: It's much cheaper than the supermarket.
zh: 比超市便宜多了。

en: We've just made some soup out of it, so we probably don't need those.
zh: 我们刚刚才拿它做了汤，所以那些大概就不需要了。

en: No, we'll get an eggplant.
zh: 不用了，我们拿个茄子吧。

en: We'll also grab eggplant, broccoli and zucchini.
zh: 我们还会拿茄子、西兰花和西葫芦。

en: We were considering getting a leek, but instead we decided to get a big sweet potato.
zh: 我们本来在考虑拿一根韭葱，不过最后决定拿一个大的红薯。

en: Considering means thinking about something before deciding.
zh: Considering 的意思是，在做决定之前先想一想某件事。

en: Some fruits are placed on individual plates.
zh: 有些水果是单独放在一个个托盘上的。

en: Each plate counts as one item at the stand.
zh: 在这个摊位上，每一盘都算一个单品。

en: It all looks good.
zh: 看起来都很不错。

en: There's a big box of limes and a big box of lemons.
zh: 这里有一大箱青柠，还有一大箱柠檬。

en: These are citrus fruits.
zh: 这些都是柑橘类水果。

en: They usually taste sour.
zh: 它们通常吃起来是酸的。

en: The tomatoes look fresh today.
zh: 今天这些番茄看起来很新鲜。

en: They're shiny and bright red.
zh: 它们油亮亮的，颜色鲜红。

en: We'll take a plate.
zh: 我们拿一盘吧。

en: Now it's time to pay.
zh: 现在该付钱了。

en: The man who works here has a big personality.
zh: 在这里工作的这位大哥人很好。

en: That means he's very friendly and expressive.
zh: 意思就是他非常友好，而且表现力很强。
